description: This dataset brings together the building standards registers of all 32 Scottish local authorities into one national layer of building warrant applications. Each local authority verifier keeps a register under Section 24 of the Building (Scotland) Act 2003, recording permission to carry out building work (the building warrant) and permission to occupy a completed building (the completion certificate); the Improvement Service's Spatial Hub collects them daily through an automated connector and publishes them as points and, where authorities record them, polygons. Records follow each application through the stages received, decided, commenced and completed. Older 'deprecated' and 'unofficial' versions are superseded by this official layer. Access: CSV, Shapefile and GeoJSON downloads and WFS and WMTS services, last updated 25 July 2025 on the page read; the WFS should be filtered, for example by local authority, because of its size. Licence: not shown on the page; a richer premium version is for public sector users. Caveats: data quality varies by authority, and polygons are incomplete. Simulation uses are tracking new construction and alterations to keep building exposure inventories current, and planning capacity. Related records: the Scotland Heat Map and UK planning decision datasets.
